verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Orb offering a natural-language command interface, such as an in-product AI assistant or chat-driven operations. Operation is documented only through the web UI, REST API, SDKs and SQL-defined metrics. The llms.txt probe makes the docs readable by LLMs, but that is an adjacent building block, not a way to operate the product in natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
